verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a consumer security app, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Ente Auth ships an in-app AI assistant that can take delegated tasks. The live llms.txt is documentation for external LLMs, and the CLI is export tooling; neither is a built-in assistant, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
